description: Exact ordered inputs of the recorded geometry-based controller. Indices start at zero. Four environmental tensors contain 361 scalars in total.

road.conv1d_added_feature: station index / 43, one deterministic positional channel per station
road.lookahead_reference: Nominal path offsets from the nearest reference station. Search selects the next geometry sample. Virtual straight extension near an open finish.

physics.name: speed
physics.transformation: Metres per second / 100

physics.name: forward_velocity
physics.transformation: Metres per second / 100

physics.name: lateral_velocity
physics.transformation: Metres per second / 20, clipped to [-1, 1]

physics.name: progress
physics.transformation: Nearest reference index / (reference point count - 1)

physics.name: yaw_rate
physics.transformation: Wrapped heading change / elapsed seconds / 3, clipped to [-1, 1]

physics.name: acceleration
physics.transformation: Speed change / elapsed seconds / 50, clipped to [-1, 1]

physics.name: heading_sin
physics.transformation: Horizontal cross product of unit car heading and road tangent

physics.name: heading_cos
physics.transformation: Dot product of unit car heading and road tangent

physics.name: gear
physics.transformation: Game gear / 5

physics.name: pitch
physics.transformation: arcsin of the vertical component of car direction, in radians

context.name: signed_lateral_offset
context.transformation: 2 × corridor fraction - 1. Left edge is -1 and right edge is +1

context.name: left_clearance
context.transformation: 2 × corridor fraction

context.name: right_clearance
context.transformation: 2 × (1 - corridor fraction)

context.name: half_width
context.transformation: Full horizontal corridor width in metres / 20, equivalent to half-width / 10

context.name: minimum_clearance
context.transformation: Minimum of the left and right normalized clearances

context.name: sideslip
context.transformation: atan2(lateral velocity, max(abs(forward velocity), 1)) / (π / 2)

context.transformation: Clipped to [0, 1]

recovery.name: speed_loss
recovery.transformation: Positive drop from previous total speed / 20 m/s

recovery.name: forward_speed_loss
recovery.transformation: Positive drop from previous forward velocity / 20 m/s

recovery.name: progress_advance
recovery.transformation: Positive change in nearest reference index / 5

recovery.name: clearance_loss
recovery.transformation: Positive drop in minimum normalized edge clearance

recovery.name: edge_approach
recovery.transformation: Positive increase in absolute lateral offset / 0.5

recovery.name: retained_speed_deficit
recovery.transformation: Positive difference between the decayed peak speed and current speed / 30 m/s. Peak time constant: 2 s

recovery.name: recovery_memory
recovery.transformation: Exponential average of the maximum speed loss, forward-speed loss, clearance loss and edge approach. Time constant: 0.75 s

quantile_input.source: Internal quantile levels, not game telemetry
